faq.question: How do I calculate shipping cost for my package?
faq.answer: Air cargo is calculated by gross weight (or volumetric weight if bulky). Sea freight is charged per Cubic Meter (CBM). Tell us your cargo description, origin country, and approximate weight, and we will calculate your exact landing quote instantly.

faq.question: Where are your international warehouse pickup addresses?
faq.answer: We have fully staffed collection hubs in Guangzhou & Yiwu (China), Houston & New York (USA), London Heathrow (UK), and Deira (Dubai). Once you register, we assign you a unique private suite ID for your shipments.

faq.question: How long does custom clearance take at Lagos ports?
faq.answer: With our pre-arrival documentation service, standard air cargo clears in 24 hours, and ocean containers or vehicles clear in 48 to 72 hours.

faq.question: Are my goods insured during shipping?
faq.answer: Yes! All shipments are covered by our standard carrier transit policy, with full 100% comprehensive marine insurance available for high-value luxury cargo and vehicles.
